steps.name: Environment & Workspace Audit
steps.command: echo "Node runtime: $(node -v)" && echo "NPM runtime: $(npm -v)" && test -d backend && test -d frontend && test -d ai-service && echo '✓ Monorepo workspace structure verified'

parallel.name: Backend Service Audit
parallel.command: echo 'Auditing Backend Service...' && cd backend && node -e "const pkg=require('./package.json'); console.log('Service: ' + pkg.name + ' v' + pkg.version);" && test -f tsconfig.json && echo '✓ Backend TypeScript configuration verified'

parallel.name: Frontend Client Audit
parallel.command: echo 'Auditing Frontend Client...' && cd frontend && node -e "const pkg=require('./package.json'); console.log('Service: ' + pkg.name + ' v' + pkg.version);" && test -f vite.config.ts && echo '✓ Frontend Vite & React configuration verified'

parallel.name: AI Service Syntax Compilation
parallel.command: echo 'Auditing AI Python Service...' && cd ai-service && python3 -m py_compile main.py && echo '✓ FastAPI AI Resume processing engine compiled and verified'

steps.name: Deployment & Compose Readiness
steps.command: echo 'Checking Deployment Assets...' && test -f docker-compose.yml && test -f nginx.conf && echo '✓ Docker Compose and Reverse Proxy configuration verified' && echo '🎉 Pipeline PASSED - All service checks passed successfully!'
